_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Ovimbundi vya Surround kwenye gridi ya {width}x{height}.
We ule muthu wakalondunge {player_id}. Mivinjili ifwete: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]' kana w/s/a/d.
Ovilo: ukalondunge kufa ovimbundi vyote vinye. Mikanda iya vifo; kugonga kwenye mbavu hufa; kugonga kwa musua hufa ovimbundi vyote viwili.

board.after_moves: Poku pitĩla konjo yaco, o yeva ondaka ya manji umue ukãi. Eye wa popia hati: {board}

game_action.invalid_death: Mwene {player_id} ali kwasha kwiilu kwa kala koshinwa.

outcome.survived_win: Mwene {player_id} ali pata kuukala; abena bale ke ba kwasha.
outcome.all_crashed: Omanu vosi va kalapo va kupuka.
outcome.turn_limit: Ekumbi liyile kwa kikomo - ukwima usobele ukuwina.
outcome.ranking: {reason} Viyemo vya kuvingilila (vya kuleta → vya kunyuma): {groups}
